# TextUnderlay

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Fonts` · record struct

```csharp
public readonly record struct TextUnderlay(Color Color, float Width = 0)
```

Types: [`Color`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Color.md)

A copy of text's glyphs drawn under its face: grown by a width, moved, softened and painted. An outline, a shadow, a glow and the depth under a title are all underlays.

## Remarks

An underlay is a CSS `text-shadow` with a spread: [`Width`](#width) grows the glyphs from the face's edges (the spread), [`Offset`](#offset) moves them, [`Softness`](#softness) fades their edge (the blur), and [`Color`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Color.md) or [`Gradient`](#gradient) paints them. With no offset or softness it's an outline; moved and softened, a shadow; softened and round, a glow; moved by a little and hard-edged, the depth under the underlay nearer the face.

[`Outline`](#outline), [`Shadow`](#shadow) and [`Glow`](#glow) make the usual ones; any of them can be changed with `with`.

Every distance is in pixels of the font's native size ([`SpriteFont.EmSize`](SpriteFont.md#emsize)), so an underlay scales with the text. The offset is in the text's own space, so it turns with turned text.

## Properties

### Color

```csharp
public Color Color { get; init; }
```

Types: [`Color`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Color.md)

The underlay's color, unless it has a [`Gradient`](#gradient).

### Corners

```csharp
public TextCorners Corners { get; init; }
```

Types: [`TextCorners`](TextCorners.md)

Gets how the underlay's corners are drawn: [`TextCorners.Sharp`](TextCorners.md#sharp), following the glyphs' corners, by default.

### Gradient

```csharp
public TextGradient? Gradient { get; init; }
```

Types: [`TextGradient`](TextGradient.md)

Gets the two colors the underlay is drawn in, top to bottom of each line as the face's are ([`TextEffects.Gradient`](TextEffects.md#gradient)), or `null` to draw it in [`Color`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/Color.md).

### MiterLimit

```csharp
public float MiterLimit { get; init; }
```

Gets, for [`TextCorners.Sharp`](TextCorners.md#sharp) corners, how many times the width a corner may extend before it's cut back, as SVG's `stroke-miterlimit`; `float.PositiveInfinity` never cuts them. 4 by default.

### Offset

```csharp
public Vector2 Offset { get; init; }
```

Gets where the underlay is drawn relative to the text, in pixels of the font's native size, in the text's own space.

### Softness

```csharp
public float Softness { get; init; }
```

Gets how much wider than a screen pixel the underlay's edge fades, in pixels of the font's native size.

### Width

```csharp
public float Width { get; init; }
```

How far the underlay extends beyond the face's edges, in pixels of the font's native size (to the middle of its fade, when it's soft). Zero is the glyphs' own shape, as a hard shadow is.
